cast.name: A
cast.dialogue_context:
Situation: The threatened relationship
Character: A
Village role: Miner
Story role: Core protagonist
Personality: Ian Beale-inspired — ambitious, commercially restless and acutely sensitive to being patronised; treats adulthood as the right to make consequential mistakes as well as profitable decisions.
State: Situation
Trigger: Available immediately when the situation begins.
Choice A: Tell Distiller that supporting Miner means taking the ambition seriously.
Consequence A: Miner feels recognised as an adult, while Distiller worries that affection is being converted into a financial test.
Choice B: Tell Miner that Distiller is allowed to love them without investing in the plan.
Consequence B: Miner is stung but begins separating the relationship from the business proposal for the first time.
cast.personality_summary: Ian Beale-inspired — ambitious, commercially restless and acutely sensitive to being patronised; treats adulthood as the right to make consequential mistakes as well as profitable decisions.

cast.name: B
cast.dialogue_context:
Situation: The threatened relationship
Character: B
Village role: Distiller
Story role: Core protagonist
Personality: Tina / young-partner hybrid — affectionate and practical but wary of being dragged into a business gamble simply to prove loyalty; wants partnership without becoming collateral.
State: Situation
Trigger: Available after Choice 1 has been resolved.
Choice A: Ask Reeve to judge the plan on its merits rather than Miner's age.
Consequence A: Reeve is forced to explain concrete licensing concerns instead of saying Miner is 'too young'.
Choice B: Ask what guarantee would genuinely reduce the market's risk.
Consequence B: The dispute becomes solvable: a capped stock guarantee and trial licence would make the risk measurable.
cast.personality_summary: Tina / young-partner hybrid — affectionate and practical but wary of being dragged into a business gamble simply to prove loyalty; wants partnership without becoming collateral.

cast.name: C
cast.dialogue_context:
Situation: The threatened relationship
Character: C
Village role: Reeve
Story role: Core mediator / witness
Personality: Pete/Lou authority hybrid — traditional, blunt and protective of the market; respects enterprise but distrusts expansion built on bravado and borrowed stock.
State: Situation
Trigger: Available after Choice 2 has been resolved.
Choice A: Ask Storekeeper to back the venture with a smaller trial allocation.
Consequence A: Storekeeper agrees to a limited first-season supply, protecting both the venture and the rest of the village stock.
Choice B: Go to the abandoned pitch, fight the creatures occupying it and reopen the space for Miner's workshop.
Consequence B: COMBAT: you clear the abandoned pitch of hostile creatures. Miner gains a real site and can prove the venture through work rather than argument.
cast.personality_summary: Pete/Lou authority hybrid — traditional, blunt and protective of the market; respects enterprise but distrusts expansion built on bravado and borrowed stock.
